summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 shareholders report, CEO/CFO certifications under Canadian National Instrument 52-109, and an earnings coverage ratio for shelf distributions. The foreign private issuer reported underlying net income of $1,146 million, up 9% year over year, underlying EPS of $2.05 versus $1.86, and reported EPS of $1.40 versus $1.97. The common share dividend rose from $0.96 to $1.00 per share, and the SLF Inc. LICAT ratio stood at 142%. No transaction, tender, or structural event is present; the filing is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure.
